  Exam Date & Time: 22-Nov-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VII Semester - End Semester Examination - Nov / Dec -2024  
  CLOUD COMPUTING [NPT-4015]  
  Marks: 50                                                                              Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Consider your Institute wants to migrate all the data to its own AWS cloud environment.  
  List out the best practices you can adapt to enhance the migration.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Elaborate in detail on why most of the industry needs to migrate to cloud environment.  
  What are all its benefits.                                                                  (5)  
  
  2)           Considered IT department of a pharmacology company want to develop software's for  
  its daily operations. They are in dilemma to choose distributed systems such as grid  
  computing or cloud computing. Justify your points to choose correct distributed systems (5)  
  A)      in detail.  
  
  B)      Identify and explain with the suitable diagrams about the different types of cloud  
  deployment models available in the cloud services.                                          (5)  
  
  3)           A data centre company called XYZ wants to virtualize its networks. Analyse how onsite  
  public cloud and hybrid cloud would help them to achieve their goal.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Provide the logical view of the IaaS cloud architecture and its operations with the neat  
  diagram.                                                                                    (5)  
  
  4)           Mention the use of Data Object storage in the cloud environment in detail. How it is  
  used to store the data in an enhanced way.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      In a Fintech company they want to setup a cloud by using hypervisor. What advantage  
  they have by using hypervisor. List the type of hypervisor and explain them in detail.      (5)  
  
  5)           A company is building a cloud-based application that needs to exchange data with  
  various systems. How can XML be used to facilitate data exchange? Also explain how  
  (5)  
  WSDL services are used in cloud environment.  
  A)
